_about: Ratchet for scripts/audit-skill-data-paths.py --engine (HOS-234). ceiling: physical data-repository paths in engine code under scripts/, .claude/hooks/, .claude/agents/ and config/ that no entry covers; it may only fall, and the goal is 0. entries: reviewed exemptions in the format of scripts/utils/statement_exemptions.py, one finding each, keyed by the full text of the line.

entries.statement: Move it to `archive/{YYYY}/` under `plans`: `P=$(python scripts/data-path.py path plans); git mv "$P/{filename}" "$P/archive/{year}/"`
entries.reason: a verbatim copy of a line of the documentation rule, which the rule-split inventory must reproduce byte for byte; archive/{YYYY} there is a subdirectory of the plans address the same line already resolves by registry name, not a path from the data root

get_data_root rule 2 asks whether the WORKSPACE root itself carries the legacy in-tree data markers; data_path imports this module, so the registry cannot be asked here, and the two segments are the marker being detected, not an address opened for its records
